Question 14
?

Which sides are consecutive to AB―?

a
CD― and EF―
b
BC― and CD―
c
CD― and DE―
d
AF― and FE―
e
BC― and AF―
Submit
Incorrect
EXPLANATION

Two sides are consecutive if they have a vertex in common. Therefore, BC― and AF― are consecutive sides to AB―.
